rationale: The buyer is real and nameable — CTOs and ML platform leads at companies with $500+/mo AI API spend, a segment that demonstrably pays for observability and cost tooling (Datadog, CloudHealth, etc.). Willingness to pay is reasonably evidenced by analogous spend on cloud cost tools. However, the core product (multi-model routing layer or spend dashboard) requires meaningful integration work (API wrappers, ingestion pipelines, usage normalization across providers) that pushes buildability below the 'shippable in a week' threshold, and ongoing delivery inherently needs some per-customer configuration or webhook setup — capping operational autonomy at 5. The HN thread has only 3 comments and 5 points, so the signal is weak and needs direct buyer validation before building.
solution_plan: The micro-service is an AI API spend monitor and alert system: customers connect their Anthropic/OpenAI/Vertex API keys and receive weekly cost digests, anomaly alerts, and a simple multi-provider fallback recommendation. The factory builds it as a Claude-powered ingestion prompt that normalizes usage JSON from provider dashboards, a lightweight intake form + Stripe subscription page, and a scheduled Claude job that emails the weekly digest — no custom infra, no coding by Youval. To sell, the factory drafts cold outreach to CTOs/engineering leads at known AI-heavy startups (Product Hunt launches, YC companies, public GitHub projects using the Anthropic SDK) — Youval approves each batch before it goes out. Delivery runs automatically: once a customer connects their keys, weekly digests and alerts are generated and sent by Claude on a cron schedule, with Stripe handling billing renewals. The only recurring human touch is approving the weekly outreach batch and reviewing any support escalations flagged by Claude. Realistic caveat: getting customers to share API keys requires real trust — positioning as a read-only audit tool (not write-access) and offering a free trial first is essential to converting.
notes: Build gates unmet: operational_autonomy=5 (below 7 floor) and buildability_with_ai=5 (below 6 floor). Stage capped at validate. Validate by posting a 'would you pay $29/mo for this?' message in AI engineering Slack communities and measuring reply intent.
